description: Result `range` values are `[start_row, start_col, end_row, end_col]`: rows are 1-based, columns are 0-based UTF-8 BYTE offsets (tree-sitter convention, not character indexes), and the end is exclusive.

language.description: One language, or use languages for several.

repo.description: Configured repo name, linked worktree directory name, or absolute checkout root. Unknown names return an error listing known repos and index status. Omit to use the primary catalog.

file_glob.description: File, directory, or glob. Bare directories include descendants; absolute paths must be inside a selected repo. A filter matching no indexed files emits filter_matched_no_files.

limit.description: Cap on captures returned before truncation. Defaults to the server `default_result_limit`, clamped to `max_result_limit`. Capture text is char-capped at `capture_char_limit`.

offset.description: Stable pagination offset over the capture stream. Use `next_offset` from the response to resume.
